_meta.superseded_by: deliverables/media-buyer/instant-form-spec-v3.json (22 Oct 2026, SOCIAL-AUDIT row 22): generic consent CONSENT-GENERIC-v5form, no practice name or FSP number, no cover question. Do NOT build this v2 form.
_meta.supersedes: deliverables/media-buyer/instant-form-spec.json (5 Oct 2026: said "free" and "licensed adviser", routed out under-35 / over-50, asked call_ok and bond/children)
_meta.build: Built by hand in Ads Manager from this file (SortMyCover Page > Instant forms > Create form). Type every string exactly as given; "chars" is its length. Meta publishes no character limits for instant-form fields: the builder shows a live counter and refuses anything too long. If the builder ever truncates a string, stop and report it (never shorten the consent text).
_meta.api_alternative: The same form via the Graph API (POST /{page_id}/leadgen_forms, automation/ads/meta-ads.js createLeadgenForm, human confirm token) sets the question and checkbox keys exactly. A form built by hand may get keys chosen by Meta; W01 then matches each answer on its exact option label, so the labels below must not be edited.
rules_applied: No "free", "costs nothing", "no cost", "licensed", "AI", "Lead Velocity" (except inside the verbatim consent text) or "Capital Legacy" anywhere on the form.
No budget, income or other financial question, no email, no health question (Meta Lead Ads restricted categories, see sources).
Every age is accepted and nothing routes out on an answer (Jono, 18 Oct 2026, the /start/ decision): no conditional logic, no disqualifying ending.
Consent box unticked by default and required; the ad-measurement box is a separate optional box, unticked (site rule S22: optional, neither choice preselected).
_meta.owner: media-buyer (strings) -> meta-operator (builds by hand, human gate at publish)

headline.text: Book a 30-minute call with an authorised adviser

description_bullets.text: Lindi from SortMyCover sends you a Start here link on WhatsApp.
We'll confirm on WhatsApp: quick answers, no call centre or waiting on hold.
You talk to an adviser for 30 minutes, by phone or video.
SortMyCover gives no financial advice, product comparisons or premium quotes.

description.text: These help the adviser prepare for your call.

questions_section.order_note: Exactly this order: the three custom questions, then the two prefill fields.

label.text: What would you like help with?

questions.mapping_note: Disability cover and Income protection are two options on the form and one /start/ intent (income, help_with disability_income); the exact option is kept in conv_state.start.intent_option for the adviser. "Not sure yet" = /start/ review. product_interest is life_cover for all five (wills are never offered on this form).

label.text: Which age group are you in?

questions.note: Every answer is accepted. 35 to 50 can be qualified (after the monthly amount, asked on the /start/ page, never in this form); Under 35 / Over 50 book like anyone, are never marked qualified, and get a timeline note (OUT_OF_BAND_AGE_BOOKS).

label.text: Do you have any life, disability or income cover now?

questions.note: Four options (Jono, 18 Oct 2026): "Yes, through work" tells Mark the cover is group cover that ends with the job (leads.work_cover true); "Yes, my own" -> work_cover false. Never ask for the insurer, a policy number or amounts (Meta: insurance information needs prior permission). Legacy answers stay readable: 'Yes' (three-option form) -> yes (type unknown), not_sure -> unsure. If Meta review rejects the form on this question, delete it and republish; W01 tolerates it missing.

Prefill question "Phone number". If the builder lets you rename the field, use "WhatsApp number"; if not, keep the prefill label: the intro, the section description and the thank-you screen all say WhatsApp. W01 normalises to +27 and checks it is a mobile (Twilio Lookup) before any message.

not_asked: budget / monthly premium / income (asked on the /start/ page the start_here WhatsApp template opens; before that template is approved: the qualify_budget template). The cover question asks about existing cover (incl. income protection), never earnings.
income, debt, health, ID number, policy details
call preference (the method is chosen when booking)

custom_disclaimer.ui: Privacy > Custom disclaimer: on. Two checkboxes, neither ticked by default.

body.text: Please read and tick to continue. The second box is optional.

checkboxes.text: I agree that SortMyCover, a service of Lead Velocity (Pty) Ltd, may message me on WhatsApp to book and remind me about my call, and may share my details with Oracle Private Wealth (FSP 28418), an adviser from an FSCA-authorised financial services provider, who may contact me by WhatsApp or phone about that call. I am 18 or older. I can opt out at any time by replying STOP.
checkboxes.source: sites/sortmycover/config/consent.json named.text with {practice_name} = Oracle Private Wealth and {fsp_number} = 28418 (Mark Weston). Must stay EXACTLY equal to consentRegistry({ practice_name: "Oracle Private Wealth", fsp_number: "28418" })["CONSENT-NAMED-v5web"]; automation/tests/W02-instant-form-v2.test.mjs fails otherwise.

checkboxes.text: I give SortMyCover permission to use my details in coded (hashed) form to measure and improve its ads on Facebook and Instagram. It will never use them to send me ads by message. This is optional, and the call does not depend on it.
checkboxes.source: sites/sortmycover/config/consent.json ads.text verbatim. Ticked -> leads.consent_ads_at (the CAPI Lead event is allowed); unticked -> no ad-measurement use.

custom_disclaimer.why_two_boxes: The ad-measurement consent is optional on the site (rule S22). Folding it into the required box would make it a condition of the call, which its own wording ("This is optional, and the call does not depend on it") rules out. So the required box carries the named text alone, exactly the CONSENT-NAMED-v5web registry entry (no new version id needed), and ad measurement is its own optional box with its own version (CONSENT-ADS-v2web).

description.text: Lindi will send you a Start here link on WhatsApp in a moment. Tap it to pick a time for your call.

after_submit: W02 webhook (leadgen) -> Graph fetch (field_data + custom_disclaimer_responses) -> W01 Lead core: consent recorded from the required box (+ the optional ad box) exactly as mapped here; stored UNROUTED like a /start/ lead (routing_reason start_page_pending, conv_state { state: start_page, via: start_page, start { intent, intent_option, has_cover, form_id, at, via: lead_ad }, help_with }).

First WhatsApp within 60 s: the start_here template (welcome banner, Hi {first name}, button Start here -> sortmycover.co.za/start/#lt=<lead token>), through smc-whatsapp-send. Gate: WHATSAPP_PROVIDER=twilio + TWILIO_CONTENT_SIDS.start_here + LEAD_TOKEN_SECRET (lib/w01.mjs startHereReady).

/start/ v4 (W39): pick a time, the adviser card with the SortMyCover disclosure (START-DISCLOSE-v1) before routing, then the monthly amount and the rest. Every age; an unknown band is provisional tier B. CAPI Lead once, at the hand-over (consent_ads only).

Before start_here is approved (gate off): the old path, unchanged: qualify_budget template first (one reminder after 3 h, deleted 24 h after it without a tap); band tapped -> W03 finishLeadAd -> the LEADAD-DISCLOSE-v1 session text -> W01 routes to Mark -> W06 broker intro card. A lead that writes in chat instead of opening /start/ also takes the taps (W03).

w02_contract.reader: automation/lib/w01.mjs normaliseLeadAd (a Graph lead, or the W02 ingest item) via leadAdAnswers / leadAdConsent; W02.json passes lead.answers and consent.responses through (automation/patch-w02-instant-form-v2.mjs).
w02_contract.matching: An answer is accepted as its option key or its exact label (case, spaces and hyphens ignored). A field whose name is not one of the keys is matched on its value against the three label sets. Unknown answers are dropped, never guessed.

checkbox_keys.other_keys: a hand-built form: a ticked box = the consent (Meta refuses a submission without the required box); the ad-measurement choice is then NOT assumed

disclosure_check.start_page: The /start/ adviser card (sites/sortmycover/src/lib/start.ts, START-DISCLOSE-v1) shows the adviser, the firm, "an authorised financial services provider (FSP n)", what is shared, and INTRO_DISCLOSURE: "Introduced by SortMyCover. SortMyCover gives no financial advice, product comparisons or premium quotes. Advisers pay SortMyCover a fee that does not depend on whether you buy anything."
disclosure_check.lead_ad_hand_over: After the band tap: W03 finishLeadAd -> W01 route_and_first_touch -> W06 broker_intro_slots (or _v2 / broker_intro_booked). The approved body names the practice, "(FSP n)", "an authorised financial services provider" and the adviser, plus STOP. It does NOT say "Introduced by SortMyCover", and carries neither the no-advice line nor the fee line (its footer is only "SortMyCover").
disclosure_check.gap: On the lead-ad path the no-advice line appears only on this form (intro bullet 4); the fee-independence line appears nowhere before or at the hand-over. Closing it needs an approved template change (Meta review), not made here.

Insurance ads: 18+ targeting; licence / authorisation where the country requires it; ads must not request personally identifiable or financial information such as bank details. South Africa is not named.

The Financial products and services special ad category is required for ads based in or targeting the United States (credit ads also Canada and parts of Europe). Not South Africa: no special ad category on this campaign.

Secondary (policy tracker): Lead Ads must not request insurance information, incl. policy numbers, without Meta's prior permission. Meta's own lead-ads terms page (facebook.com/legal/leadgen/tos) could not be fetched (redirect loop); the same tracker logs an unverified July 2026 removal of this clause. Treated as still in force.
Secondary: financial information (incl. income, net worth, debt) needs prior permission: why the budget band stays off the form.
